description: Check whether a UK bike's frame (serial) number matches a theft report held by Cyclesite. Live data, checked on every call. Rate-limited per serial number (3 an hour) to prevent enumeration. Example: 'does frame number WTU123456 match a theft report?'. Someone who has found a bike, rather than bought one, can check the frame number and leave the owner a message at https://www.cyclesite.co.uk/stolen-bikes/found.
name: check_stolen
